title: Discriminating outside rows where the worker sometimes fails, with graded hidden metrics
body:
Why: Fable 1115b slice 2; easy rows ceiling at K 3/3 so no arm differs.
Outcome: 6-8 public fixed-issue candidates (fix spans >=2 files, body symptom-only, existing suite); K once per row; summary gains hidden-case fraction, suite regressions, Stop refusals, turns, cost.
Proof: >=3 rows with K below 100%; each harness failure fixed with a regression test. ~$2-3. Touches scripts/outside-acceptance.ts and scripts/outside-hidden/tasks.json.
